purpose: Bounded native four-GPU GR00T capacity and managed-allocation lifecycle screen, not paged speed or final task-quality qualification
single_factor: 55GiB of ordinary CUDA storage in one explicit supervised co-resident process per GPU; zero reservation in the all-resident control. No hidden allocator cap or optimizer fallback.

pressure_choice_evidence.interpretation: 55GiB plus the observed resident peak exceeds80GiB before the reservation context. This requires cache reclamation and/or migration. Cached memory makes eviction uncertain; only measured transfer/fault evidence can establish managed migration. No promise that paging creates additional capacity over nonpaged8bit.

controls.recipe: unchanged native FP32-master recipe, actor5e-6/value1e-4, BF16 model/compute/reduction, microbatch2/global64, same approved model/manifests
controls.hardware: 4 A100-SXM4-80GB,32CPU,256GiB; existing routing, serial owned GPU allocations
controls.checkpoint_format: v3 after passed CPU large-state and two-GPU recovery tests

dependent_recovery: After a successful paged pressure reference, evaluate its checkpoint16 in a new process under the same reservation, then continue16→32. If pressure fails, retain that failure and use the successful resident checkpoint16 for the independent v3 paged native recovery check; do not call that pressure recovery.
migration_diagnostic: Only after successful pressure training/recovery: one separate eight-update paged pressure run under Nsight Systems2025.1.1, CUDA UM CPU/GPU fault tracing enabled. Capture a bounded600-second interval starting600seconds after launcher start, kill=none. Profile overhead excludes this run from performance claims. Retain counter unavailability/errors; no new pressure level is automatically admitted.
acceptance: All intended actor/value updates finite; frozen source and native behavior log-probability checks pass
All managed moment owners remain managed across fresh restore; exact restored learner state and control match before new updates
No score/success receipt on failure or changed source generation
Physical simulator reset on completed-window resume remains explicit
Report observed window times and all native delivery costs, host PSS and device/process usage including the synthetic reservation separately
No statistical quality or paging speed win from one seed or window-level pseudoreplication
stop_conditions: No automatic reservation-size search. An arm failure does not cancel independent arms. Recovery only admitted from a complete published checkpoint. No repeated full run to obtain a favorable pressure outcome.
cost_forecast: Approximately25-40minutes per32-window native run and10-25minutes per dependent evaluation/resume, plus one bounded profile. Actual allocation charges and failures retained; no aggregate cap.
